column1: # The prompts cogwork's sounds were made from, for tools/sfx.sh: one sound per line, its files
# going to assets/sounds/<file><n>.ogg for n = 1..variants. Columns, separated by tabs:
# file, variants, seconds, prompt influence (0-1), prompt.

column5: Single stroke of a small wooden piston engine driven by a coiled steel spring: soft wooden creak, a firm thunk and a light ratchet click. Close up, dry, isolated game sound effect, no music.
Single stroke of a heavy iron steam piston engine: a deep metallic chuff with a short exhale of steam over a low coal firebox rumble. Close up, isolated game sound effect, no music.
Coal catching fire in a small iron firebox: a soft whoosh of flame swelling, then crackling embers. Close up, isolated game sound effect, no music.
Overheated steam engine cutting out: a sharp hiss from a pressure valve, hot metal ticking and a short shrill warning whistle. Isolated game sound effect, no music.
Iron engine cooling down after overheating: metal pings and ticks as it contracts, then a short soft hiss of relief. Isolated game sound effect, no music.
Short wooden suction thup as a small object is sucked into a glass tube and slides away. Close up, dry, isolated game sound effect, no music.
A small object vanishing in a muffled vacuum pop with a tiny fizzle. Close up, isolated game sound effect, no music.
Clunk and rattle as a stuck object is ejected from a glass pipe and drops out. Close up, isolated game sound effect, no music.
Iron beam clanking into place on a scaffold frame, followed by a quick bolt ratchet. Isolated game sound effect, no music.
Diamond-tipped mechanical drill biting into rock: short grinding crunch with a rising motor whine. Isolated game sound effect, no music.
Big clockwork machine finishing its work: heavy gears spinning down and slowing, then a deep final clunk as it settles. Isolated game sound effect, no music.
Small brass clockwork machine finishing a craft: gears turning, a press stamping down and a tidy mechanical ding. Close up, isolated game sound effect, no music.
Machine-driven shovel blade scraping through earth and loose dirt in one short stroke. Isolated game sound effect, no music.
A block of earth pressed down into a hole with a firm thud and a tamp. Isolated game sound effect, no music.
Wrench ratchet turning a bolt: three quick metallic clicks. Close up, dry, isolated game sound effect, no music.
A surveying instrument measuring out an area: a soft electric hum rising into a glassy shimmer and a light chime. Isolated game sound effect, no music.
Very soft, short glassy tick, a subtle user interface click. Isolated, no music.
